cuts.item: Pavement management line reduced to zero
School budget cut of about a million if no override
Possible layoffs at the school department
Recycling program as a possible cut if pavement management is restored
Mosquito control program as a possible cut

statements.statement: The town manager's proposed budget reduced the pavement management line to zero.
Bridging the school gap between the town manager budget and the level-service budget would need roughly two million, not counting a one-time transfer.
With pavement management and debt service restored, an override this year would come to nearly three million.
The town manager recommended no override this year and a joint override next year, and said the town needs an override to maintain services.
Certified free cash was stated as the base for the plan.
The town manager could support giving roughly half a million of free cash to the schools as a one-time bridge, plus or minus.
If the plan is approved, free cash would start next year at this amount.
Total state aid receipts under the Governor's House 1 budget.
Total new money available for town and school budgets in FY26, apportioned by budget share.
Schools' share of new revenue under the apportionment approach.
Debt service decreases as debt rolls off, and part of it supports the operating budget.
Health insurance rises sharply and is expected to hold at that level in future years.
Snow and ice line was increased.
A member projected a next-year override need around four million.

warnings.about: one-time funds and next year's override
warnings.condition: if next year's override does not pass
warnings.prediction: Using one-time free cash now while promising a larger override next year is risky if the override fails; next year's budget will be worse.
Free cash generated next year will likely be lower.

warnings.about: health insurance line and free cash
warnings.prediction: Cutting the health insurance line closer to actual will hurt next year's free cash.

warnings.condition: if pavement management is restored within the levy
warnings.prediction: Departmental cuts would mean cutting people, not supplies, if pavement management is restored within the levy.

warnings.condition: if an override does not pass
warnings.prediction: Voters must be told that without an override staff will be fired and services reduced.

warnings.condition: if there is no structural change
warnings.prediction: Without a plan the town will be back with budget crises every year; the school budget will keep shrinking.
